# Within-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://www.parsebiosciences.com/datasets/5-million-mouse-single-cell-atlas-from-7-tissues/>

```{r}
mouse_ref_adata = read_h5ad('data/02_annotation_refs/mouse.h5ad')
mouse_count_matrix = t(mouse_ref_adata$X)
colnames(mouse_count_matrix) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
rownames(mouse_count_matrix) = mouse_ref_adata$var |> rownames()
mouse_metadata = as.data.frame(mouse_ref_adata$obs)
# the obs index (0, 1, ..., "0-1") is not cell_ids, and CreateSeuratObject matches
# meta.data rows to cells by name: name them like the count matrix columns
rownames(mouse_metadata) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
stopifnot(identical(rownames(mouse_metadata), colnames(mouse_count_matrix)))
mouse_metadata$barcode = mouse_metadata$barcode |> 
  str_remove('_5d84e6de$')
mouse_ref = CreateSeuratObject(counts = mouse_count_matrix,
                               meta.data = mouse_metadata)
# transfer dimensional reduction (umap)
mouse_umap_coords = mouse_ref_adata$obsm$X_umap
rownames(mouse_umap_coords) = mouse_ref_adata$obs$cell_ids
colnames(mouse_umap_coords) = c('UMAP_1', 'UMAP_2')
mouse_ref[['umap']] = CreateDimReducObject(embeddings = mouse_umap_coords,
                                           key = 'UMAP_',
                                           assay = 'RNA')
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  NormalizeData()

rownames(mouse) = mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id
mouse_shared_genes = rownames(mouse) |> 
  intersect(rownames(mouse_ref))
mouse_ref = mouse_ref[mouse_shared_genes,]
mouse_ref$nCount_RNA = colSums(x = mouse_ref[['RNA']]$counts)
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 0)
mouse_ref@meta.data = mouse_ref@meta.data |> 
  mutate(across(c(`B Cell`, `Colonocyte/DCC`, `Enteric Glial`, `Enteric Neuron`, Enterocyte,
                  Fibroblast, Goblet, Immune, PCC, Mesothelial, `Plasma Cell`, 
                  `Smooth Muscle`, `Stem/TA`, Tuft, `Vascular Endothelial`, Unknown), 
                ~ na_if(.x, 'None'))) |> 
  mutate(cell_type_detailed = coalesce(`B Cell`, `Colonocyte/DCC`, `Enteric Glial`, 
                                       Enterocyte, `Enteric Neuron`,Fibroblast, Goblet, 
                                       Immune, PCC, Mesothelial, `Plasma Cell`, 
                                       `Smooth Muscle`, `Stem/TA`, Tuft, 
                                       `Vascular Endothelial`, Unknown))
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  subset(!is.na(cell_type_detailed) & !cell_type_detailed == 'Unknown')

mouse_cells = mouse_ref$cell_type_detailed
mouse_ref$cell_type_regroup = case_when(
  mouse_cells %in% c('Colonocyte/DCC', 'PCC', 'Enterocyte') ~ 'Epithelial: Absorptive',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Goblet', 'Tuft') ~ 'Epithelial: Secretory',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Stem/TA') ~ 'Epithelial: Stem/Progenitor',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Vascular Endothelial') ~ 'Endothelial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Fibroblast', 'Mesothelial') ~ 'Stromal/Mesenchymal',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Smooth Muscle') ~ 'Smooth muscle',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Enteric Glial', 'Enteric Neuron') ~ 'Neural/Glial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('B Cell', 'Plasma Cell') ~ 'B/Plasma',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Immune') ~ 'Immune'
)

SaveSeuratRds(mouse_ref, 'data/02_annotation_refs/mouse_processed_mouse_use.rds')
```

## Seurats

```{r}
mouse_ref = readRDS('data/02_annotation_refs/mouse_processed_mouse_use.rds')
mouse = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
rownames(mouse) = mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id

# background QC before annotation
mouse_cells = fread("data/00_raw_data/Xenium_V1_mouse_Colon_FF_outs/cells.csv.gz",
                    select = c("cell_id", "cell_area"))
mouse$area = mouse_cells$cell_area[match(colnames(mouse), mouse_cells$cell_id)]
keep_cells = bg_filter(nCount_probe_controls = mouse$nCount_ControlProbe,
                       nCount_transcripts =  mouse$nCount_Xenium,
                       cell_areas = mouse$area,
                       n_genes = dim(mouse)[1],
                       n_total_probes = 20)
mouse = mouse[,keep_cells]

mouse = mouse |>
  NormalizeData() |>
  ScaleData() |>
  RunPCA(features = rownames(mouse)) |>
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE) |>
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:20)

mouse_seurat_label = LabelTransfer(data = mouse, ref = mouse_ref)
mouse$celltype_seurat = mouse_seurat_label$cell_type_transfer
mouse$labelscore_seurat = mouse_seurat_label$score_transfer
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
```

```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')

  geom_histogram()
ggplot(mouse@meta.data, aes(x = celltype_seurat, y = labelscore_seurat)) +
  geom_boxplot()
DimPlot(mouse, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'celltype_seurat',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

# Cross-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://cellxgene.cziscience.com/collections/f11cb29c-b546-4738-9bd8-66ea621a7bd5>

```{r}
mouse_ref = read_h5ad('data/02_annotation_refs/human.h5ad')
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
rownames(mouse) = mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$ensembl_id
mouse_ref = mouse_ref$as_Seurat()
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  subset(control_vs_disease == 'control') |> 
  subset(organ_unified |> str_detect('colon')) |> 
  subset(donor_disease %in% c('control', 'organ_donor')) |> 
  subset(!sample_retrieval %in% c('Medical_termination', 'Oral sample', 'Unspecified')) |> 
  subset(sample_category == 'Non_pathological')
# human.h5ad (CELLxGENE) X is log1p(CP10k): undo the log so NormalizeData() below gives back X
mouse_ref@assays$RNA$counts = expm1(mouse_ref@assays$RNA$X)
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  NormalizeData()

homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')
mouse_ref_mouse = concatenate(mouse_ref, mouse, homology_tbl)
rownames(mouse_ref_mouse) = mouse_ref_mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene
DefaultAssay(mouse_ref_mouse) = 'RNA'
DefaultLayer(mouse_ref_mouse[['RNA']]) = 'data'
mouse_ref_mouse = mouse_ref_mouse |> 
  subset(orig.ident == 'hsapiens')

mouse_ref_mouse$nCount_RNA = colSums(x = mouse_ref_mouse[['RNA']]$counts)
mouse_ref_mouse = mouse_ref_mouse |> 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 0)

mouse_cells = mouse_ref_mouse$level_2_annot
mouse_ref_mouse$cell_type_regroup = case_when(
  mouse_cells %in% c('Absorptive') ~ 'Epithelial: Absorptive',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Secretory', 'Enteroendocrine') ~ 'Epithelial: Secretory',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Epithelial_stem', 'Transit_amplifying') ~ 'Epithelial: Stem/Progenitor',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Vascular_endothelia', 'Lymphatic_endothelia', 'Cycling_endothelia') ~ 'Endothelial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Fibroblast', 'Myofibroblast', 'Pericyte', 'Mesothelium', 'Lymphoid_stromal_cell') ~ 'Stromal/Mesenchymal',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Smooth_muscle') ~ 'Smooth muscle',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Glia', 'Neuron', 'Neuron_progenitor') ~ 'Neural/Glial',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Mature_B', 'Immature_B', 'B_plasma') ~ 'B/Plasma',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Conventional_CD4', 'Conventional_CD8', 'Treg', 'NK', 'Unconventional_T/ILC', 'Cycling_T/NK', 'DC', 'Macrophage', 'Monocyte', 'Granulocyte') ~ 'Immune',
  
  mouse_cells %in% c('Erythrocyte') ~ 'Erythroid'
)

SaveSeuratRds(mouse_ref_mouse, 'data/02_annotation_refs/human_processed_mouse_use.rds')
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

rownames(mouse) <- mouse@assays$Xenium@meta.data$gene_name

annotators <- c("celltype_seurat", "celltype_singleR",
                "celltype_seurat_cross", "celltype_singleR_cross")
n_per_type <- 3
dir.create("dotplots", showWarnings = FALSE)

# match names regardless of spaces, underscores, colons, slashes, case
key <- function(x) tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z]", "", x))

short <- c("B/Plasma" = "B/Pl", "Endothelial" = "Endo",
           "Epithelial: Absorptive" = "Abs", "Epithelial: Secretory" = "Sec",
           "Epithelial: Stem/Progenitor" = "Stem", "Erythroid" = "Ery",
           "Immune" = "Imm", "Neural/Glial" = "Neur",
           "Smooth muscle" = "SMC", "Stromal/Mesenchymal" = "Strom")
short_by_key <- setNames(unname(short), key(names(short)))

# ---- marker list: genes present, each once, first n per type ----
markers <- lapply(markers, \(g) intersect(g, rownames(mouse)))
seen <- character(0)
for (n in names(markers)) {
  markers[[n]] <- head(setdiff(markers[[n]], seen), n_per_type)
  seen <- c(seen, markers[[n]])
}
markers <- markers[lengths(markers) > 0]
panel_keys <- key(names(markers))                 # remember order for rows
names(markers) <- ifelse(panel_keys %in% names(short_by_key),
                         short_by_key[panel_keys], names(markers))

# ---- one slide-sized plot per annotator ----
plots <- list()
for (ann in annotators) {
  keep <- colnames(mouse)[!is.na(mouse[[ann, drop = TRUE]])]
  obj  <- subset(mouse, cells = keep)
  Idents(obj) <- ann

  # order rows to follow the panels (top row = first panel)
  lv  <- levels(factor(Idents(obj)))
  pos <- match(key(lv), panel_keys)
  lv  <- lv[order(is.na(pos), pos)]
  Idents(obj) <- factor(Idents(obj), levels = rev(lv))

  p <- DotPlot(obj, features = markers, dot.scale = 7) +
    labs(title = sub("celltype_", "", ann), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 13, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                         face = "italic"),
          axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 15),
          strip.text.x    = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(6, "pt"),
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 13),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 12))

  plots[[ann]] <- p
  ggsave(file.path("dotplots", paste0(ann, "_slide.png")), p,
         width = 13.33, height = 7.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}
```

# EBCC

```{r}
print('EBCC')
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
rownames(mouse) = mouse[['Xenium']]@meta.data$gene_name
markers <- list(
  Pan_epithelial  = c("Epcam","Krt8","Krt19","Cldn7","Cdx1"),
  Stem_Progenitor = c("Sox9","Gpx2","Stmn1","Cenpf","Ube2c"),
  Absorptive      = c("Cdhr5","Selenbp1","Hsd11b2","Car2","Tspan8","Fxyd4"),
  Secretory       = c("Chgb","Neurod1","Insm1","Scg5","Nts","Ltc4s"),
  Endothelial     = c("Kdr","Clec14a","Plvap","Tie1","Eng","Vwf"),
  Lymphatic       = c("Lyve1","Prox1","Mmrn1"),
  Smooth_muscle   = c("Myh11","Des","Cnn1","Tagln","Pln"),
  Pericyte        = c("Rgs5","Higd1b","Ndufa4l2"),
  Stromal         = c("Lum","Dpt","Pi16","Sfrp1","Mfap4","Sod3","Bmp2"),
  Neural_Glial    = c("Plp1","Gfap","Sox2","Snap25","Tubb3","Gap43"),
  Immune          = c("Laptm5","Rac2","Ctss","Lst1","Cybb"),
  T_cell          = c("Cd3d","Cd8a"),
  Myeloid         = c("C5ar1","Ms4a7","Mpeg1","Csf3r","Cxcr2","Cpa3"),
  B_Plasma        = c("Sdc1"),
  Erythroid       = c("Slc4a1","Rhd","Hemgn","Slc25a37","Fech")
)

# keep genes on the panel, each gene once (first group wins)
present = lapply(markers, intersect, rownames(mouse))
seen = character(0)
for (g in names(present)) { present[[g]] = setdiff(present[[g]], seen); seen = c(seen, present[[g]]) }
present = present[lengths(present) > 0]
setdiff(unlist(markers), rownames(mouse))   # markers not on your panel

ann_cols = c("celltype_seurat", "celltype_singleR", 
  'celltype_seurat_cross', 'celltype_singleR_cross')
# hide one random annotator's label for 10% of cells
set.seed(1)
meta_ho = mouse@meta.data
ho = data.frame(cell = sample(nrow(meta_ho), round(0.1 * nrow(meta_ho))))
ho$ann   = sample(ann_cols, nrow(ho), replace = TRUE)
ho$truth = mapply(function(i, a) as.character(meta_ho[[a]][i]), ho$cell, ho$ann)
for (a in ann_cols) {
  meta_ho[[a]] = as.character(meta_ho[[a]])
  meta_ho[[a]][ho$cell[ho$ann == a]] = NA
}

DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_seurat') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse[,!is.na(mouse$celltype_singleR)], features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_singleR') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_seurat_cross') + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse[,!is.na(mouse$celltype_singleR_cross)], features = markers, group.by = 'celltype_singleR_cross') + RotatedAxis()

trusted = list(
celltype_seurat = c('Endothelial', 'Immune','Smooth muscle'),
celltype_singleR = c('Endothelial', 'Neural/Glial', 'Smooth muscle'),
celltype_seurat_cross = c('Endothelial', 'Neural/Glial', 'Smooth muscle'),
celltype_singleR_cross = c('Endothelial', 'Neural/Glial', 'Smooth muscle', 'Stromal/Mesenchymal')
)
frac = 0   # chosen by the held-out (M, frac) grid, 1-SE rule (see mouse_ebcc_heldout_grid.csv)
n_k = list(
  celltype_seurat = table(mouse$celltype_seurat),
  celltype_singleR = table(mouse$celltype_singleR),
  celltype_seurat_cross = table(mouse$celltype_seurat_cross),
  celltype_singleR_cross = table(mouse$celltype_singleR_cross)
)
# every label any annotator gives, so the prior covers all classes run_ebcc sees
all_classes = mouse@meta.data[ann_cols] |> lapply(as.character) |> unlist() |> na.omit() |> unique()

# fit with M subtypes, then score how well the hidden labels are predicted
heldout_ll = function(M, R = 3) {
  beta = make_beta_prior(all_classes, ann_cols)
  for (a in names(trusted)) {for (k in trusted[[a]]){
  beta[[a]][k, k] = 4 + frac * n_k[[a]][[k]] / M }}
  f = run_ebcc(meta_ho, ann_cols, M = M, R = R, keep_rho = TRUE, beta = beta)
  lp = unlist(lapply(ann_cols, function(a) {
    s = ho[ho$ann == a, ]
    l = match(s$truth, f$classes); ok = !is.na(l)
    # P(hidden label) = sum over class-subtypes of P(cell in it) x P(annotator gives that label)
    log(rowSums(f$rho[s$cell[ok], , drop = FALSE] *
                t(f$par$v[[a]][, l[ok], drop = FALSE])))
  }))
  lp
}

Ms = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 10)
ll = sapply(Ms, heldout_ll)
mean(ll[,1])
mean(ll[,2])
mean(ll[,3])
mean(ll[,4])
mean(ll[,5])
mean(ll[,5]) - sd(ll[,5])/sqrt(dim(ll)[1])

# ---- fit ----
M = 5   # chosen by the held-out (M, frac) grid, 1-SE rule (see mouse_ebcc_heldout_grid.csv)
beta = make_beta_prior(all_classes, ann_cols)
for (a in names(trusted)) for (k in trusted[[a]])
beta[[a]][k, k] = 4 + frac * n_k[[a]][[k]] / M 
fit = run_ebcc(mouse@meta.data, ann_cols, M = M, R = 10, beta = beta)

# ---- diagnostics ----
# 1. restarts: distance of each restart's ELBO from the best (large spread = many local optima)
round(fit$elbo_restarts - max(fit$elbo_restarts), 1)

# ---- save ----
mouse$ebcc_label   = fit$label
mouse$ebcc_maxpost = rowMaxs(fit$posterior)
mouse$ebcc_entropy = -rowSums(fit$posterior * log(fit$posterior + 1e-12))
mouse$celltype   = mouse$ebcc_label   # switch over only once the diagnostics look sound

save_marker_dotplots(mouse, markers, c(ann_cols, 'ebcc_label'), prefix = 'mouse',
                     out_dir = '../figures/colon/annotation',
                     file_names = c('seurat', 'singleR', 'seurat_cross', 'singleR_cross', 'ebcc'))

VariableFeatures(mouse) = rownames(mouse)
mouse = mouse |> 
NormalizeData()  |> 
ScaleData()
mouse$celltype = mouse$ebcc_label
saveRDS(fit$par,       'data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_params.rds')
saveRDS(fit$posterior, 'data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_posterior.rds')
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
as.anndata(mouse, file_path = 'data/02_annotated_data/',
           file_name = '02_mouse_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'Xenium',
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```
